headline: Labour MPs warn UK prime minister against blocking Rosebank oilfield
summary: Dozens of Labour MPs are pressuring the UK prime minister not to block the North Sea Rosebank oilfield project, warning of political consequences in Scotland.
why: North Sea oil and gas development projects involve significant capital expenditure by energy companies and impact domestic energy supply, employment, and regional economic policy.

impacts.name: United Kingdom
impacts.why: Decisions on North Sea oilfield developments affect domestic energy production policies and regional economic output in the UK.
